classification_statement: Chongqing is still too ambiguous for fair A.T.O.M. validation. The public material supports source-level quantity description, but not an authoritative absolute-RSRP or relative-propagation validation claim.

classification_options.C_quantity_validation_only: not selected because transmitter, release, identity, frequency, and receiver metadata remain jointly unresolved for a fair quantity-validation adapter

blockers: antenna gain and directional pattern are absent
raw/base frequency semantics do not reconcile
receiver calibration, antenna, and SS-RSRP resource semantics are absent
serving-cell mapping is incomplete for 342 rows
unknown directional antenna pattern can create angle-dependent residuals
unresolved carrier/frequency join prevents frequency-specific comparison
identity gaps and PCI mismatches weaken serving-cell assignment
route/session and receiver-height metadata are incomplete
claimed SHP/configuration reproducibility package is not in the audited file list
relative_propagation.safe_scope: Descriptive source-level variation only; no adapter or fair A.T.O.M. residual claim.

quantity_validation.reason: The SS-RSRP field is a named dBm quantity, but the information needed to define a reproducible validation quantity and isolate transmitter/receiver effects is not complete.

power_gain_pattern_decision.power_field: Antenna transmit power(dBm) is source metadata only; dBm unit is known but reference plane and gain inclusion are unknown.
power_gain_pattern_decision.gain: No authoritative maximum gain or antenna model found.
power_gain_pattern_decision.pattern: No horizontal/vertical pattern, beamwidth, codebook, or vendor radiation data found.
power_gain_pattern_decision.consequence: Do not compute EIRP, do not use source power as canonical tx_power_dbm, and do not fit an offset to hide missing pattern information.

identity_frequency_decision.identity: Exact NCI-to-ECI mapping is accepted only for the 81077 mapped rows; 342 rows remain unresolved and PCI is not a safe fallback.
identity_frequency_decision.frequency: Raw NR-ARFCN can be converted under ETSI rules, but base Downlink Frequency has zero exact agreement and non-constant conditional deltas; no rewrite is allowed.

receiver_rsrp_decision.receiver: iQOO 8 Pro/Snapdragon X60 is documented for UAV measurements; Cellular-Pro and the UAV/ground collection modes are documented.
receiver_rsrp_decision.rsrp: Raw SS-RSRP may be retained as a source quantity, but it is not approved as independently calibrated absolute received power for A.T.O.M. validation.

six_a_three.reason: The required metadata reconciliation gates did not pass; a 6A.3 adapter pilot would force assumptions about power, pattern, frequency, identity, or receiver semantics.
future_reconsideration_prerequisites: Pin one official release and provide matching checksums and runnable loading script.
Resolve all eight missing NCI/ECI keys and the 254 PCI inconsistencies with source-owner evidence.
Document base frequency fields and exact raw-to-base carrier mapping.
Document power reference plane, antenna model/gain/pattern, or explicitly constrain a future study to a defensible source-only quantity.
Release receiver/antenna/calibration, ground receiver height, route/session, and SS-RSRP measurement-resource metadata.
Deliver or link the claimed GIS sampling-point and application-configuration supplement.
six_a_three.next_action: Stop at research artifacts; do not build or stage an adapter.

six_b.reason: Concept 6B remains gated on independent usable samples, complete metadata, deterministic mapping, reproducible provenance, holdouts, and review.

invariants.concept_6a2: unchanged: external benchmark audit only; no benchmark selected and no adapter
